seo.title: ODDfest — Helsinki's open Creative Week
seo.description: A week-long, free and open program built by and for Helsinki's creative community — art, club culture and collective creation across the city's venues.

title: Helsinki's open Creative Week.
intro: A week-long, free and open program built by and for Helsinki's creative community — art, club culture and collective creation across the city's venues, running straight out of ODDference and into the streets.

features.title: Art & Performance
features.body: Installations, live shows and everything in between, spread across Helsinki's creative venues.

features.title: Club Culture
features.body: Nights that don't end when the program does — DJs, collectives, and the city after dark.

features.title: Collective Creation
features.body: Open calls, co-created works, and space for anyone with something to bring.
